module_responsibilities: Performs offline keyword/bi-gram retrieval over captured fragments and memories with per-term scoring and snippets.
Tokenizes both ASCII words and CJK, and is the only retrieval backend used in review mode (no embeddings).
boundaries: No embeddings / vector search; matching is literal LIKE after tokenization.
Read-only over the review DB; it never writes memory rows.

key_flows.name: search
key_flows.description: searchSources tokenizes the query, ORs per-term fragment matches, and ranks by term weight.

risks_and_limits: Per-term LIMIT and top-N are callers' responsibility; this module cannot rank across categories.
Literal tokenization misses synonyms and semantic similarity.
unknowns: Recall/precision on the real corpus is not measured here.

claims.text: class KeywordRetrieval is declared in apps/server/src/retrieval/keyword.ts
tokenize splits ASCII and CJK text into query terms
searchFragmentsForTerm runs one escaped LIKE per term

evidence.text: export function tokenize(text: string): string[] splits on whitespace/punctuation; collects ASCII words /[A-Za-z0-9_.\-]+/g lowercased, and CJK runs /[一-鿿][一-鿿0-9A-Za-z_.\-]*/g, emitting each full run plus filtered 2-grams, returning non-empty trimmed terms.
Local embedding/reranker weights may be added via osdk when semantic retrieval is implemented.
